g.text: Round81: frozen BDS-C at common 3600-second caps
Markers are audited checkpoints; dashed lines only guide the eye. Missing physical U means no plotted gap.
An outlined square marks committed evidence after a whole-run hard stop; it is not a certificate.
D6 has no fresh K1 control. These are exposed development roles, not independent confirmation.
